title: From a moving brief to a shared direction. — Cynthia Udoh
description: Cynthia Udoh is a Lead Project Manager & Communications professional, connecting people, creative work, and clear delivery.

section_01.text_004: From a moving brief to a shared direction.
section_01.text_005: Creative projects rarely move in a straight line. A change in copy can affect design; a design decision can affect development. My role is to make those relationships visible.

section_02.text_010: Different disciplines need different information. When expectations sit across calls, messages, and files, the team can work hard without working toward the same outcome.
section_02.text_012: I translate conversations into trackable tasks, connect feedback to the relevant deliverable, and coordinate across design, motion, video, and web contributors. I keep client updates connected to the work the team is actually doing.
section_02.text_014: Start with the agreed scope. Break the work into deliverables. Give each task an owner, a status, and a useful reference. Bring decisions and open questions into the next review so changes are intentional.
section_02.text_016: The team can see what is ready, what is waiting, and what needs a decision. Progress is understood through the work and its dependencies, rather than a reassuring status label alone.
section_02.text_017: This working method is illustrated by the named project examples below. Creative execution is credited to the wider project team.
